content: Individuals diagnosed with diabetes are permitted to consume alcohol within the recommended limits, which align with general health guidelines. Specifically, this means up to one alcoholic drink per day for women and up to two drinks per day for men. However, those who are on insulin therapy or taking certain diabetes medications should exercise caution. This is because alcohol consumption can elevate the risk of hypoglycemia (low blood sugar) or cause delayed drops in blood glucose levels, which may pose significant health risks.
